Meanwhile...
scene nikiamicards1
: TSA guidelines now prohibit Go-Gurt on airplanes...
scene nikiamicards2
: What’s Go-Gurt?
: It’s like a...tube of yogurt. For people who want to eat yogurt on the go.
: Are there actually people like that?
: There won’t be for long if the TSA has anything to do with it.
scene nikiamicards3
: Okay. Well...I guess that one wins then?
: It’s not like there are any other options to choose from. Playing this game with two people doesn’t really work well, does it?
: No...but at least we’ll both win?
scene nikiamicards4
: Is there anything you want to do instead, Ami? Maybe we could watch a movie or something? I brought a few of my old concert DVDs as well since I know you’ve been wanting to see them.
: I’m fine with anything, really. Just being here with you makes me happy.
scene nikiamicards5
: Didn’t I tell you to stop saying things like that when the two of us are practically family already?
: Yeah. But I’m actually family with Dad and I still say stuff like that to him all the time. Why should I not be happy to spend time with the people I love?
scene nikiamicards6
: F...Fair enough. I just wasn’t sure if you were saying that because I’m your favorite idol or because you actually like me, you know.
: Of course I like you, Niki. You’ve been so nice to me lately...always coming over to check in on me. Taking care of me while Dad is gone.
: Though, I’m not really sure why I need to be taken care of in the first place when I’ve more than proven that I can take care of both myself and someone else.
: When I’m not busy accidentally stabbing them, at least.
: I think it’s less “taking care of you” and more just “keeping you company” so you don’t get bored while all of your friends are at the beach.
: They’re not really my friends anymore.
scene nikiamicards7
: Ami, that’s not-
: Yeah it is. The only ones who have bothered checking in on me this whole time have been Ayane and Maya. Even the other girls at the maid cafe have been kind of weird to me.
: Which is fair. I did threaten to dismember them and all. But it’s okay. Really. I don’t need that many friends. Just my family and the other members of the Love Squad are enough for me.
scene nikiamicards8
: Love Squad?
: That’s the name me and Ayane gave our group of friends since we all love Dad and will do anything he asks of us. Maya hasn’t accepted she’s a member, but we all know she is.
: It’s kind of annoying, really.
: So Noriko and I aren’t in the Love Squad? How’s that fair? I’ve loved Akira even longer than you have if you want to get technical about it.
: That’s true. But you only just came back into his life a little while ago. So you weren’t around when the group was formed.
: Also, Ami. It’s not really healthy to say things like “we’d do anything he asks of us.” He’s your Dad-slash-uncle, not your boyfriend.
scene nikiamicards9
: Ooooh, did I make you jealous just now? Is my love for my dad so strong that even his childhood friend is envious of it?
: Of course not. I just don’t want you thinking your entire life revolves around him when you’re going to grow up and fall in love with someone else one day.
scene nikiamicards10
: Pass!
: Pass?
: Yeah. I’m never going to fall in love with anyone else. I’m not interested in that.
: I mean...you say that now. But you never know what will happen in the future and-
: Sure. But you never fell for anyone else, did you? What makes you think that I’m any different?
: Probably the part where I’ve just been hopelessly in love with Akira for my entire life and that I’d never be able to break free even if I wanted to.
: Yeah. And it’s the same for me. I’m just also related to him.
: Which would make a relationship with him even more illegal than it already is.
scene nikiamicards11
: Some laws are meant to be broken.
: Ami, why do you look at him like that?
scene nikiamicards12
: Huh? What do you mean?
: You know what I mean. These feelings you have aren’t normal. I’m worried about you.
: You’re worried about me because I have romantic feelings for my dad?
: Yes. Literally yes. That is a thing that people worry about.
: Why?
: Well...it’s just...weird. And there’s a power dynamic at play here that makes things really...icky.
: But it’s okay if the feelings are just one-sided, isn’t it?
: It’s not like Dad has ever capitalized on my feelings for him. Which he could if he wanted to. But then me and you would have to fight and I don’t want that because I like you.
: Did I...say something wrong?
scene nikiamicards13
: No...yes? I don’t know. It’s just a little difficult for me to understand you sometimes since I’ve never wanted to sleep with any of my family members.
: Not even in your fantasies?
: Of course not, Ami.
: Wow. That’s kind of crazy to me.
scene nikiamicards14
: Yeah, because you’re a creepy little gremlin with no grasp on the laws of the land and I’m a mostly normal girl with abnormal taste in boys.
: Guess that makes me a little abnormal too then, huh?
: A little?
: A girl’s first love is always her father, Niki!
: But Akira-
scene nikiamicards15
: Ugh. Forget it. We can continue this another time.
: Can we?
scene black
: Do you want anything from the kitchen? I think I’m gonna make some food. Akira said you had some stuff in the fridge for the two of us to share.
: Mmmm...can you make tea? I finished mine right before the TSA banned portable yogurt.
scene nikiamicards16
: Sure thing, Ami. No food?
: No thanks! I’m not really hungry right now.
As Niki Nakayama peered through the confines of the Arakawa family refrigerator, she wondered about the best way to tell her prospective daughter that incest is wrong.
It was a situation she hadn’t ever imagined finding herself in until the thoughts of moving into this place begun, but it was one she was now mostly prepared to confront.
What she did not know is just how impossible such a task would be as Ami Arakawa had never even considered being with someone who doesn’t share her blood.
The blood was what turned her on. She’d dream of bathing it. Drinking it. Filling up a cup and pouring it over her head in the midst of an orgasm to further accentuate those impure feelings.
Just that’s not what she really thought. Probably. Most of the time. Some of the time. Maybe she never thought of blood at all. Maybe she was hemophobic. Maybe she wasn’t even real.
But whatever the case, Niki’s plan was never going to work. And that was something she’d have to eventually resign herself to if she ever did want to become Ami’s mother.
Which she shouldn’t. She should get away from here as quickly as possible. She should change her name and marry a salary-man or a music producer or something like that.
But she keeps wanting to fuck Akira Arakawa and his magic cock because it’s the only cock she’s ever known and it’s a good one so why bother finding another when-

scene nikiamicards17
: Hm?
: What’s that in the back of the freezer?
scene nikiamicards18
: Nothing!
: What? When did you get there?
: It’s nothing! Don’t even worry about it! In fact, why don’t we order a pizza?! Or Chinese?! Frozen food isn’t great for you, you know?! And you should really watch your figure as an idol!
: You’re being...kind of weird, Ami. Like, even more than normal.
scene nikiamicards19
: Hahahaha! That’s me! Head completely empty! Nothing in there but controversial views on familial relationships! And kittens! And anime! I’m such a goober! Hahahah!
: Hahahahahahah! Hahahah...hahaha...
: You good?
scene nikiamicards20
: Yup! But why don’t we just close this and...
scene nikiamicards21
: There! All better. Now, you won’t have to worry about contaminating your precious body with all of that junk, am I right?
: I...guess so?
scene black
: Great! Movie time it is, then!
scene nikiamicards22
The two girls sat down on the couch, clearing the table of games best played in groups and replaced them with drinks and stacks of DVDs they knew they weren’t going to watch.
And in this moment, the two of them were happy. The two of them were at peace. Like mother and daughter.
scene nikiamicards23
But the real mother was there too. Well, not real. But also kind of real. The ghost mom! The one who liked children in every way possible.
In a dark corner of the room, just out of reach of the television’s glow, she stood there in all her ghostly envy — wishing she could be the one providing a lap pillow right now.
But unfortunately (or fortunately based on who you ask) she was very, very dead. And also very, very mad that this impostor would try to take her place.
Niki Nakayama did not feel this gaze.
scene nikiamicards24
Ami Arakawa did.
But she was unsure of what she was supposed to do about that.
On one hand, she loved her mother. On another hand, she loved Niki. And she longed for the lap of an older woman but, once more, not in the yuri kind of way.
This much was fine though, wasn’t it?
She wasn’t openly welcoming her into the home. And she’d been as polite as possible earlier in letting Niki know that she would steal her “boyfriend” away without a second thought.
That damage — the broken piece of furniture she was would surely dissuade her idol from joining the household, would it not?
If each bed was broken — each floorboard cracked, then Niki would take her kindness elsewhere and leave Ami to her castle of callous thoughts. Again, not a hint.
And again, incorrect. For in the throes of those happy thoughts, peace would break apart when the two of them realize there’s only room for one on their make-believe raft.
: I’m sorry...
: Sorry for what, Ami?
I don’t know which of them she apologizes to, but I like to believe its both.
I like to believe that Ami did not just feel the presence of her very, very dead mother, but that she saw her. That she could hear her breathing.
That she could listen closely to the way her ghostly feet made contact with those cracked floorboards so vividly that she could make out the shape of them.
And I want to believe that because that’s how this story should go.
This house has not been a home for a very long time. And it deserves a scene like this devoid of the negative connotations that make it, for lack of a better word-
Doomed.
: You know...
: You’ve never really told me about your mom before.
scene nikiamicards25
The ghost’s attention was piqued.
She’d heard her daughter speak of her before and hung on every single word. But never in the presence of one who may take her place.
Would her words remain the same? Or had the seeds of self-doubt already been sown in her precious little girl’s field of dreams?
: You don’t have to talk about her if you don’t want to. I get how hard it is for you. Akira too.
: You both really loved her, didn’t you?
: She was...
: The closest a girl could ever come to perfection.
scene nikiamicards26
: Oh yeah? How so?
: Just...everything. She was pretty. She was funny. She was talented. And she loved me...so deeply that I’ve never felt anything like it.
scene nikiamicards27
: She’s what I want to be...my hero. But she was way smarter than me and I highly doubt I’d ever be able to catch up even if I gave it my all.
: That’s not true, Ami. You’re young. You’ve got plenty of time to catch up.
: No, you don’t get it...She wasn’t smart like normal people are smart. She understood things. Things about God...things about the world...all sorts of things.
: Her words alone could change the way you see. They could change what you hear...what you think. She was so good at just...impacting people. Changing people.
: I saw it every day when she was raising me. How everyone fell in love with her at first glance. And it was like she took that love and just...bundled it up to give to me.
: I remember one day...I was probably only four or five back then...but she took me to the top of a hill where you could overlook the whole city.
scene nikiamicards28
: She put me up on her shoulders...and even though she was so small and skinny, I never thought for a second that I was going to fall.
: She sung to me...spun me around beneath her favorite tree...read me some of her favorite poems...and I still dream about that day sometimes.
: How it was like we were the only two people in the world. And sometimes, I wish we were.
: Sometimes, I wish I could rewrite the past. Figure out a way to put someone else in her place so that they could die instead of her.
: And yeah...I know that’s an evil thing to think. But she’s worth it. She’s worth more than anyone. She was just that perfect.
scene nikiamicards29
: That’s all just a fantasy, though.
: The truth is no one could ever replace her. Not even in death.
: She still watches over me. I can feel her. I can smell her sakura perfume.
: And I just hope that she’s proud.
: I’ll die happy if I can be half the mom that she was. I just wish I could explain it better.
: It feels like anything I say doesn’t even come close to painting a real picture of her. But that’s just one more example of how she was everything I’m not.
scene nikiamicards30
: Ami...
scene nikiamicards31
: Huh?
: Niki?...
: What’s wrong?
: Nothing, I...
: I just thought I...heard something.
: The washing machine maybe? I threw my uniform in there a little while ago.
: Yeah...
scene black
: Yeah...that must have been it.
It wasn’t.
